paper_metadata.title: Impacting Financial Predictions & Security through Quantum Support Vector Machines, Quantum Approximate Optimization, and Quantum-Resistant Lattice Cryptography

summary: The paper proposes a hybrid quantum-finance framework combining QSVM, QAOA, QPCA, and QBM. Reported simulator results include 92.3% anomaly detection accuracy with QSVM (vs ~78–85% classical), Sharpe ratios up to 1.50 using QAOA portfolio optimization, ~95% variance retention after dimensionality reduction via QPCA, and ~87–89% accuracy for financial time-series prediction using QBM. All evaluations were performed in a hybrid simulator environment without specified quantum hardware resources.
